name: Aaron
summary: Moses' brother, who spoke for him before the people and before Pharaoh. God chose Aaron and his sons to serve Israel as priests.

key_moments.title: Speaks the LORD's Words to the Elders
key_moments.description: The LORD sent Aaron to meet Moses in the wilderness. Aaron told the elders everything the LORD had said and did the signs, and the people believed.

key_moments.title: The Rod Becomes a Serpent
key_moments.description: Before Pharaoh, Aaron threw down his rod and it became a serpent. Egypt's magicians did the same, but Aaron's rod swallowed theirs.

key_moments.title: Makes the Golden Calf
key_moments.description: While Moses was away on the mountain, the people asked Aaron to make them gods. He made a calf from their gold earrings and built an altar in front of it.

key_moments.title: His Rod Buds and Blossoms
key_moments.description: A rod for each tribe was laid in the tabernacle, with Aaron's name on the rod of Levi. By the next day Aaron's rod had budded, blossomed and grown almonds, showing God's choice.

key_moments.title: Death on Mount Hor
key_moments.description: On Mount Hor, Moses took off Aaron's garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron died on the mountaintop, and all Israel mourned him thirty days.
